card.name: Leading cause of death phrases
card.fires_on: Words inside ranking phrases about causes of death or illness, such as "leading", "second", or "of" in "leading cause of". Also "for" after "accounted" in mortality statistics.

modes.label: Ranking phrase
modes.description: The ranking word or "leading" before "cause" in statements of how a condition ranks as a cause of death.

modes.label: Link after cause
modes.description: The word "of" after "leading cause" or "for" after "accounted" in death statistics.
modes.example: In 1996, suicide was the 3rd leading cause<< of>> death in 15 to 2
